title: Bank of America resets Marvell stock price target after Nvidia deal

title: KKR (KKR) to Privatize Taiyo Holdings via Tender Offer
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 将通过要约收购将 Taiyo Holdings 私有化
summary: KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE:KKR) is one of the best US stocks to buy and hold for the next 3 years. On March 31, KKR and Taiyo Holdings announced an agreement for KKR to acquire the company through a tender offer, leading to its privatization.
summary_zh: KKR & Co. Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：KKR）是未来三年最值得购买和持有的美国股票之一。 3月31日，KKR与Taiyo Holdings宣布达成协议，KKR将通过要约收购方式收购该公司，从而将其私有化。
